message.content:
Determining the “best” player in soccer today depends on what criteria you’re using—goal-scoring, overall influence, skill set, or current form. As of now, many pundits and fans point to a few names:

| Player | Position | Current Club | Why they’re often cited |
|--------|----------|--------------|-------------------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Forward/Playmaker | Inter Miami (MLS) | Still producing goals and assists at a high level; his playmaking remains elite. |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | Forward | Paris Saint‑Germain | Combines speed, finishing, and creativity; consistently among the top scorers in Ligue 1 and Europe. |
| **Erling Haaland** | Striker | Manchester City | Record‑breaking goal‑scoring rate in the Premier League and Champions League. |
| **Kevin De Bruyne** | Midfielder | Manchester City | One of the world’s best passers; orchestrates attacks and scores from distance. |
| **Neymar Jr.** | Winger | Al‑Hilal (Saudi Pro League) | Still a creative force and a prolific scorer when fit. |

If you’re looking at pure statistics over the last season, **Erling Haaland** leads in goals per game across all competitions, while **Kevin De Bruyne** tops key passes and assists. In terms of overall influence on games, many analysts still consider **Lionel Messi** to be the most complete player, even though he’s older than the others.

Ultimately, the “best” player is a matter of personal preference and the specific attributes you value most.
